title: Book Two · Chapter 13: The Soft Ball
story:
On Saturday afternoon, Mum takes Ronan to a small square near Jun's home. Jun and Leo are there with Jun's mother. There is no road through the square. The women sit on a bench beside the low wall.

Leo has a soft ball. Jun has two pieces of chalk.

“We need a goal,” Leo says.

Jun draws two short lines on the ground. The gap between them is narrow.

“Roll it through here.”

Leo stands back. He throws the ball hard. It hits a stone and jumps over the lines.

“Not over,” Jun says. “Through.”

“The ball chose over.”

“Then the ball has no point.”

Ronan takes his turn. He bends low and rolls gently. The ball goes between the chalk lines. He puts both hands above his head.

“One point.”

Jun rolls next. His ball goes left. On his second turn, it goes left again.

Leo moves one chalk mark.

“Now it is easier.”

“That is not the same goal,” Ronan says.

“For the next game,” Jun says. “Not this one.”

They finish the narrow game first. Ronan wins by one point. Then Jun draws a wider goal. Now everyone gets through more often.

A breeze lifts Mum's clean towel from the bench. She catches one end. Ronan catches the other.

Leo looks from the towel to the ball.

“We could catch with that.”

Mum checks the ground. There is no mud on this part. She lets them use the towel for a little while.

Ronan holds two corners. Leo holds the other two. Jun puts the ball in the middle.

“Up,” Jun calls.

Ronan lifts his hands. Leo lifts later. The ball rolls into Leo's shirt.

He holds it against his stomach.

“I caught it.”

“With the wrong thing,” Ronan says.

“Still a catch.”

They try again. This time Jun counts to three. The ball rises a little and drops back into the towel.

All three shout. Mum looks over from the bench.

“We heard,” she says.

Jun wants a turn at one end. Ronan gives him the corners. Leo holds the towel. Ronan puts the ball in the middle and gives the count.

The next throw goes too high. Leo steps toward Jun. Jun steps toward Leo. Their heads almost meet, and the ball drops between them.

Both boys stop. Then they both laugh. They sit on the ground for a moment.

“Lower next time,” Jun's mother says. “And keep space between you.”

Ronan rolls the ball back. They practise three small throws. On the third, the ball lands on the very edge. Jun lifts his corner just in time.

Later, Mum takes the towel back. One corner is dusty. Ronan brushes it with his hand. She folds the clean side inward.

Leo asks about another game next Saturday.

“I need to ask at home,” Ronan says.

“So do I,” Jun says.

They walk to the corner together. Leo tries to roll the ball along the top of his own arm. It drops at once. Ronan catches it near the ground and gives it back.

Jun draws a tiny goal in the dust with his shoe.

“Try that one.”

Leo puts the ball right in the little gap. Then he steps back and bows.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

roll＝滚动；gap＝空隙；soft＝软的；turn＝轮到的一次。

## 理解问题

1. 三个人怎样修改游戏，让大家都能参与？
2. Ronan这次在哪一轮赢了？

## 读句子

**Leo / holds / the towel.** Leo／拿着／毛巾。
